Amazon Makes Another Effort to Slice Into $1 Trillion Grocery Industry–What to Know
The tech and retail giant is expanding its same-day grocery shipping in another bid to capture a bigger piece of the $1 trillion grocery market.

Amazon is making another concerted effort to capture a larger slice of the $1 trillion U.S.
grocery
industry.
The Seattle-based online retail and technology giant
announced
on Aug. 13 that it will expand its same-day delivery service to include perishable groceries in 1,000 markets. Amazon plans to extend its coverage to more than 2,300 markets by the end of 2025.
